::: {#def-exposure-mapping .theorem}
## Exposure mapping

A function $g_i : \{0,1\}^{K \times n} \to \mathbb{R}^m$

such that

$$
Y_i = f_{Y_i}\big(g_i(\mathbf{X}_1,\dots,\mathbf{X}_K), U_{Y_i}\big).
$$

where $f_{Y_i}$ is the [structural equation](#def-npsem) for $Y_i$, and vectors $\mathbf X_t$ are each an equivalence class induced by the [equivalence](#def-equivalence) relation among the parents of $Y$.

:::
